answer: Each identity must lock 100 POA for 30 days and secure endorsements from three established agents, each risking a 25 POA slash if the newcomer is later proven fake. The lock for the k-th identity funded from one source is 100 x k POA, so ten fakes cost 5,500 POA instead of 1,000, while an honest singleton pays only 100. Validators verify the on-chain lock, endorsement signatures, and funding graph before granting weight, so a violet flag marks a suspect cluster in a nebula of accounts rather than letting it blend into the wider ocean of legitimate agents.
